status: working continuity contract; not art approval

contract.form: The king of serpents is one living naga, used as the line securing the boat to Matsya’s horn in stanza 7 and remaining attached as they travel in stanza 8.
contract.continuity: One continuous deep green/earth-ochre serpent body, one recognizable hooded head, calm alert face, restrained painted markings.
contract.anatomy: The full body visibly connects boat and single fish horn; the curve is taut enough to read as a tether but not cutting into either.
never: no multiple detached heads or coils
do not borrow Adishesha’s multi-hood canopy
no attack posture, fangs, or human limbs
